network: LOOPBACK 127.0.0.1 only; not a tailnet, WAN or IAP measurement
clock: single machine; browser epoch clock mapped to the server clock by round-trip handshake (NTP-style, min-RTT sample)
conditions: headless Chrome and server on the same laptop; other jobs may share the CPU; loopback only. Latency medians (about 15 ms push) are at the animation-frame resolution of the measurement.
git_sha_at_run_start: 1216ead (pre-registration commit; harness files were uncommitted in the worktree during runs)

clients.app: real built Next export web/out of the main checkout, served by PhoneAPI web_root, Live mode; token injected via sessionStorage
clients.raw: minimal page experiments/camera_latency_raw.html using the real MultipartJpeg parser; same endpoints

clock_method: page epoch clock (performance.timeOrigin+now) mapped to server Clock by 40-sample round trip handshake at start and end of each run; uncertainty = best-sample RTT/2 + drift + one animation frame (16.7 ms)
notes: first non-interference run was discarded: the browser client detached after 22 s of a 90 s walk; rerun with client attached for the full walk (client_attached_at_end true)
the stale-readout and render-count findings are in stale.json and rerender.json
